messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: GPU host offline (host-az3-gpu-17) — reason: kernel oops + PCIe reset detected by driver. Alert level: P1. PD incident: PD-4821.
Sam K: Acked. I'm on it, grabbing console now.
Priya N: Thanks. Noted increased 5xxs from dedicated customers in us-west2, dashboard shows spike starting 05:02 UTC.
Sam K: Console shows repeated `pcie bus error` logs and then `kernel: BUG: unable to handle kernel NULL pointer dereference` followed by kernel oops. Host is not responding to kubelet heartbeat.
Chris W: Can we live-migrate any pods off this host? Which racks have spare GPU capacity?
oncall-rotation: @Sam K, you're primary. @Priya N, you're secondary for customer comms. I'll rotate escalation to infra if needed.
Sam K: Trying `kubectl get nodes` — node is `NotReady` and `Kubelet` is `Unknown`. Attempting `kubectl drain host-az3-gpu-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` but API returns timeout.
Priya N: Opening a ticket with SRE and sending an incident banner to #general-prod with the high-level impact. Draft: "GPU host host-az3-gpu-17 unexpected kernel oops, potential impact to dedicated inference lanes in us-west2. Teams: eng-oncall."
Sam K: Starting remote powercycle via BMC. `ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.6.17.21 -U root chassis power cycle` — BMC did not respond initially, retrying.
Chris W: If BMC fails, plan B is rack OOB; I'm coordinating with colo. Also preparing a fallback policy: reroute requests to alternative GPU pool and if not available, to CPU fallbacks with reduced concurrency.
Ops Bot: Canary route update applied: route/us-west2/dedicated -> fallback-gpu-pool-2 (soft-shed enabled) at 05:06 UTC.
Priya N: Customer impact: 12 dedicated instances affected (list attached in ticket), some experiencing increased latency and a few timeouts. Communicating ETA unknown until node responds.
Sam K: BMC responded, powercycle initiated. Monitoring serial console... kernel hang persists, looks like NVMe errors + PCIe resets at boot.
Chris W: Escalating hardware: requesting replacement host. Kicks off automated reprovision: `reprovision-host --host host-az3-gpu-17 --image gpu-1.2 --skip-live-migrate` (manual confirmation required).
Sam K: While hardware replacement queued, I'm cordoning node to prevent further scheduling: `kubectl cordon host-az3-gpu-17` (done).
Priya N: Posted update to customers: "We're routing traffic away from affected host and provisioning replacement hardware. Degraded performance may persist for some workloads. Will update in 15 minutes or when we have an ETA."
oncall-rotation: @Chris W can you take over primary after hardware handoff? I'm going offline for 20 to sleep.
Chris W: Taking over. Noted. I'll follow through with reprovision and confirm when the replacement is up and tests pass.
Ops Bot: Reprovision job queued (job-7759). Estimated completion ~30 minutes, awaiting tech on-site to swap faulty board.
Sam K: Before handoff, I captured dmesg excerpt to ticket: ```[  123.456789] pcieport 0000:3b:00.0: AER: Corrected error received: id=0010
[  123.456793] nvme nvme0: I/O 0 QID 0 timeout, aborting
[  123.456800] kernel: BUG: kernel NULL pointer dereference at 0000000000000008```
Priya N: Logging notes for postmortem: customer impact, timeline, remediation steps (cordon -> powercycle -> reprovision), and mitigation improvement: add automatic shift of dedicated routes after host kernel oops detected.
Chris W: Follow-ups for post-incident: (1) ensure BMC network isolation detection is improved, (2) add automated immediate reroute when kubelet heartbeats stop for GPU hosts, (3) create pre-approved reprovision flow for rapid hardware swaps.
Chris W: Update: reprovision completed and replacement host published to cluster as host-az3-gpu-17 (reprovision job-7759 succeeded). Running smoke tests.
Ops Bot: Smoke tests: GPU inference smoke (short) passed. All affected pods rescheduled and running.
Priya N: Update sent to customers: "Host replaced, workloads recovered, please open a support case if you still see issues."
Sam K: Marking incident as mitigated. I'll file a brief postmortem draft. Leaving detailed logs in PD-4821.
oncall-rotation: Thanks all — handing back to normal rotation. :thumbsup:
__comment: Thread is a single continuous string with messages in chronological order. All fields are strings or list of strings per agents.md.
